hooks.PostToolUse: if [[ $LAST_TOOL_OUTPUT == *'Successfully modified'* && ($LAST_TOOL_FILE == *.ts || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == *.py) ]]; then echo 'Checking types...'; bun run lint; fi
hooks.PreToolUse: if [[ $LAST_TOOL_FILE == *.env || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == *lock || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == out/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == */out/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == memory/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == */memory/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == .claude/handoffs/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == */.claude/handoffs/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == memory-system/.claude/handoffs/* || $LAST_TOOL_FILE == */memory-system/.claude/handoffs/* ]]; then echo 'Warning: Protecting sensitive/local-only files. Do not print secrets or commit private artifacts.'; fi
